system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Common, Rot. No item slots.

You are in debt big time. Your Oligarch has a lot of demands, and you are behind already on paying them off.

Starting Debt (Passive): When you take this inherited item, work with your GM to define the task you owe your Oligarch. This forms a personal quest for you. Every Long Rest you do not complete the quest, gain 1 Bane Token. When you complete the quest, gain 1 Influence with your Oligarch and 1 Lore Point.

Rulebook p.33.
